//: worksOnTemplate: true = this agent's work belongs on the template branch; false = it doesn't; absent = either. The session start warns on a mismatch.
//unowned: Paths no role owns: only the human and unrestricted roles, such as the free-agent, edit them.

spec-agent.summary: Helps the human write executable specifications. Never implements.

app-agent.summary: Makes a committed, failing spec pass. Never touches specs or the harness.

harness-agent.summary: Improves the harness and the template. Writes no specs or app code.

free-agent.summary: No ownership limits, for cross-cutting work. Cross-agent changes are reported.
